info.name: Fantasy EPL League Manager API
info.description: Every HTTP endpoint currently implemented in EplFantasy.Api, generated from API_ENDPOINTS.md / src/EplFantasy.Api/Controllers. Auth uses a bearer JWT set at the collection level via {{accessToken}} -- run 'Register' or 'Login' first and their test scripts will populate {{accessToken}}/{{refreshToken}} automatically for every other request. 'Create League', 'Create Season', 'Create Fantasy Team', 'Create Draft', and 'Create Invitation' likewise auto-save their new resource's id into {{leagueId}}/{{seasonId}}/{{fantasyTeamId}}/{{draftId}}/{{invitationId}} so the natural creation order (League -> Season -> Fantasy Team -> Draft) chains through the rest of the collection with no manual copy-pasting. Everything else (playerId, clubId, gameweekId, membershipId, etc.) needs to be filled in by hand from an earlier response, since this collection doesn't try to guess which specific player/club/gameweek you want to exercise.

request.description: Confirms the API is running and its database connection is healthy. No auth required.
Create a new user account.
Authenticate with username/password; returns an access token + refresh token.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access/refresh token pair (rotates the refresh token).
Revoke the caller's current refresh token.
Request a password reset link for an email (always responds the same way, whether or not the email matches an account).
Complete a password reset using the token from the request step.
Get the caller's own user profile.
Change the caller's own username.
Set the caller's platform-wide default profile icon.
List the catalog of available profile icons.
Create a new League (caller becomes its founding Administrator).
List the caller's own League memberships.
Get a League's details.
Update a League's details.
Invite a user to the League. `seasonId` is optional (omitted here) -- add it back to scope the invitation to one Season instead of the League as a whole.
List a League's outstanding invitations.
Revoke an invitation.

Accept an invitation by its unguessable token (the token itself, not a membership check, is this endpoint's real security boundary). No endpoint returns this token -- it's delivered out-of-band (email/SMS); set {{invitationToken}} manually from wherever your environment surfaces it (e.g. a dev-only log line or direct DB read).
List a League's memberships.
Get one membership.
Leave a League (self, or an Administrator removing another member).
Set a League-specific profile icon override.
Clear the League-specific icon override (falls back to the platform-wide default).
Get this membership's notification preferences.
Update this membership's notification preferences (array of {eventType, channel, enabled}).

Create a new Season for a League. eplSeasonIdentifier must already exist as an epl_seasons row (seeded via tools/EplFantasy.SeedTool, or your own sync) -- it's a platform-level anchor, not something this call creates for you.
List a League's Seasons (optionally filtered by status).
Get one Season.
Get a League's default configuration values.
Update a League's default configuration values.
Get a Season's own (possibly overridden, possibly field-locked) configuration.
Update a Season's configuration (rejected whole if any changed field is locked).
List a League's announcement messages.
Post a new League announcement message.
Paginated administrative-action audit log for a League.
Create the caller's FantasyTeam for a Season.
List every FantasyTeam in a Season.
Get one FantasyTeam.
Get a FantasyTeam's full squad, including released-player history (filterable/sortable by position/search/sort).
Mark a squad player as season-ending-injured, granting a replacement opportunity.
List a FantasyTeam's unspent replacement opportunities.
Spend a replacement opportunity to pick a new player.
Get a FantasyTeam's season goal prediction.
Submit/update a FantasyTeam's season goal prediction.

Start a Draft (only draftType: Initial is supported today). Requires at least 2 FantasyTeams already created for the Season (BR-302) -- a single-user run through this collection only creates one, so expect a 409 insufficient_fantasy_teams until a second user/FantasyTeam exists.
List a Season's Drafts (optionally filtered by draftType).
Get a Draft's current state (turn, timer, pending makeup picks, etc.).
Make the current pick (only the FantasyTeam currently on the clock may call this). Include an Idempotency-Key header for safe retries.
Extend the current pick's timer deadline.
Paginated list of picks made so far, in order.
List undrafted players still available (filterable/sortable by position/search/sort).
Get a FantasyTeam's roster for a Gameweek.
Submit/replace a FantasyTeam's roster for a Gameweek (rejected once locked). Supports an If-Match header carrying the row's xmin for optimistic concurrency.
Change the roster's designated Captain without touching the rest of the roster.
Administrator correction of an already-locked/scored roster's players and/or Captain.
Get a FantasyTeam's calculated score for a Gameweek.
Create a manual score override for a player's Gameweek performance.
Undo (deactivate) an existing score override.
Get the head-to-head match schedule (optionally filtered to one Gameweek).
Get one head-to-head match's result.
Get the League's current (or as-of-a-past-Gameweek) standings table.
List all EPL clubs.
List EPL players (filterable by clubId, position, search).
Get one EPL player.
List Gameweeks for a given EPL season.
List a Gameweek's fixtures.
Get the real-world EPL league table for a season.
View the current rate-limiting configuration.
Paginated feed of recorded security events (rate-limit blocks, etc.).
Report whether cookie auth / CSRF middleware is active (informational; this API is bearer-JWT only today).
Soft-delete (retire) the caller's own account; username becomes reusable. Deliberately the last request in this collection -- run it only when you're done exercising everything else as this user.
